items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: 3% of previous day's closing balance. Resets at 17:00 EST. Floating + realized PnL combined. Example: $110k balance → floor at $106,700. Intraday profits expand the limit.

items.label: Max Overall Loss
items.detail: Trailing drawdown based on High Water Mark (previous day's EOD balance). Locks at initial balance once 7% profit is reached. Example: $100k → floor at $93,000, trails up as balance grows, locks at $100,000 once balance exceeds $107,000.

items.label: Consistency Score
items.detail: Biggest winning day ÷ total account profit ≤ 20% at all times — applies during trading AND for payout eligibility. If exceeded, keep trading until ratio drops to 20% or below.

items.label: Min Trading Days
items.detail: No minimum trading days required.

items.label: Risk Per Trade Idea
items.detail: Max 2% of initial balance per trade idea. Correlated assets = 1 idea. New trade within 10 min of close = same idea. SL required. Violation = instant termination. Effective 7 Apr 2026.

items.label: Inactivity Limit
items.detail: No new trade in 30 consecutive days = permanent suspension.

items.label: Time Limit
items.detail: No evaluation phase — funded from day 1. No time constraints.

items.label: KYC Deadline
items.detail: KYC documents and contract must be uploaded within 48 hours of purchase. Required before any payout.

items.label: Expert Advisors (EAs)
items.detail: No EAs allowed on Direct Model accounts under any circumstances.

items.label: Active Account Limit
items.detail: Max 2 Direct accounts can be traded simultaneously. Must wait for one to be breached before activating a third.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: No open/close within 5 min before/after high-impact news. SL/TP activation during this window = violation. Holding existing positions through news is allowed only if opened 5+ min before. Low/medium-impact news unaffected.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: All trades must be closed before 15:45 EST Friday. Any open position at that time is auto-closed AND account is terminated.

items.label: Overnight Hold
items.detail: No restrictions on overnight positions.

items.label: Bi-Weekly
items.detail: Every 14 calendar days from first trade. Requires Consistency Score ≤ 20%. No minimum profit threshold stated.

items.label: Upgraded
items.detail: Profit split can be increased to 90% via an add-on at purchase.

rows: Bank Wire / Crypto (BTC, USDC, ETH, USDT)

items.label: Swap-Free
items.detail: Example: $1,049 → $1,153.90. Must be selected at purchase.

items.label: Reset Add-on
items.detail: Reset add-on is NOT available for Direct accounts.

items.label: Profit Split Upgrade
items.detail: Split can be upgraded up to 90% via add-on at purchase.

items.label: Max Total Funded
items.detail: Combined cap across all active funded accounts (challenges + direct).

items.label: Merging
items.detail: Direct accounts have no merging option — not challenge-based.
